On this page

Customization ​

Plots is highly customizable through prefabs and translation files.

Custom Prefabs ​

You can create your own prefabs for the world generator. Place them in the mods/Plots/prefabs directory.

Configurable Prefabs ​

  • Plot: The main building area.
  • Road: The roads between plots.
  • Intersection: The crossroads.

WARNING

Ensure your prefabs match the dimensions configured in config.json. If a prefab is larger than the plot area, it will be cropped. If it is smaller, it will be centered.

Translations ​

The plugin supports multi-language support. A default en_us.json is generated on first run.

To add a new language:

  1. Copy en_us.json and rename it (e.g., pt_br.json).
  2. Translate the values.
  3. Change the Language setting in config.json to your new language code.
json
{
  "General": {
    "Language": "pt_br"
  }
}
